verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm, a professional legal services provider rather than a software product or platform, so connecting an agent through an official MCP server is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no software interface the firm ships to clients. Its legaltech pages describe internal AI adoption and a startup incubator, and llms.txt returns a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
